# Transmission, ZF 8HP (EGS) (0x18)

<!-- Generated by tools/channel_docs.py from the catalogs. Do not edit. -->

3526 channels from `gszfb1.prg`. Function groups are keyword-based (see [decoding](../decoding.md#function-groups)). Value tables: [GSZFB1-values.md](GSZFB1-values.md).

Columns: **ID** is the identifier read with service 0x22; **Field** is the value's place in a multi-value reply (`@n` = fixed byte offset); **Scaling** applies to the raw number; **Values** is the value table (written out when short).

Too many for one page; one page per group:

- **Versions, coding & identification** (21): [page](GSZFB1-versions-coding--identification.md)
- **Gearbox & driveline** (3505): [part 1](GSZFB1-gearbox--driveline-1.md), [part 2](GSZFB1-gearbox--driveline-2.md)
